mission.title: Mission
mission.description: Promote, regulate, and oversee mining activity in La Rioja so that it develops in a responsible, sustainable, and transparent manner, and translates into employment, opportunities, and well-being for the people of La Rioja. We do this in coordination with communities, municipalities, the productive sector, and the education and science system, strengthening mining that is integrated into the territorial and productive development of the province.

general.title: General objective
general.description: Transform La Rioja’s geological and human potential into real development, with modern, inclusive mining and a Riojan identity, that grows in an orderly, equitable, and sustainable way, generates value and opportunities in the territory, and is strategically integrated into the provincial productive matrix.

items.one: Modernize and strengthen the mining regulatory and institutional framework, promoting a unified, clear, and up-to-date system that provides legal certainty, streamlines procedures, and improves coordination among the Province, municipalities, and the Nation.
items.two: Create conditions of predictability and competitiveness for the development of mining activity, promoting responsible investment, strengthening Riojan suppliers, encouraging value added, and improving access to and use of up-to-date geological, mining, and environmental information.
items.three: Strengthen the systems for oversight, inspection, and monitoring of mining activity, ensuring compliance with current regulations, continuous follow-up of projects, and coordination with environmental authorities and other competent bodies.
items.four: Link the education, science, and technology system with provincial mining development, expanding opportunities for education, training, research, and job placement, especially for young people and women.
items.five: Strengthen transparency and access to mining information, ensuring clear, accessible, and timely information on projects, procedures, controls, and results, as a basis for dialogue and community participation.

publicPolicies.title: Public policies
publicPolicies.intro: The Secretariat of Mining of La Rioja promotes a mining policy aimed at developing the activity in a responsible and sustainable way, coordinated with the needs of the province and its communities.
publicPolicies.body: Within the framework of the Five-Year Plan for Mining Development 2026–2030, its lines of action are organized into five strategic pillars. They seek to generate investment, strengthen local capacities, promote employment and Riojan suppliers, protect the environment, and strengthen participation and access to information.

modernization.title: Institutional and regulatory modernization
modernization.description: Updating of rules and procedures, simplification and digitalization of procedures, generation of mining information, and strengthening of the State’s technical capacities to promote, regulate, and oversee the activity.

investment.title: Investment and the local economy
investment.description: Promotion and support of mining projects, creation of conditions for investment, and strengthening of the activity as part of the provincial productive development strategy. It includes the development of a provincial registry for Riojan suppliers and labor, with training, assistance, and coordination with mining companies, so that they can take part in the opportunities generated by the activity.

environment.title: Environment and community
environment.description: Strengthening of mechanisms for environmental assessment, oversight, and monitoring, together with opportunities for community information and participation. Participatory environmental monitoring and coordination with public bodies, municipalities, and local institutions are promoted.

education.title: Education, employment, and territory
education.description: Creation of training and education opportunities linked to mining activity, in coordination with universities, educational institutions, and local governments. Special attention to local employment and the training of young people and women, so that Riojan workers can access opportunities in the sector.

communication.title: Mining communication
communication.description: Development of tools to facilitate access to information on mining activity, projects, controls, opportunities, and results, strengthening institutional communication, transparency, and dialogue with communities.

quienesSomos.title: Who We Are
quienesSomos.body: We are the competent authority responsible for planning, regulating, promoting, and overseeing mining activity throughout the provincial territory. Our purpose is to foster the development of modern, inclusive mining with a strong Riojan identity, strategically combining economic growth with social well-being and environmental care. We work under a participatory model that coordinates efforts with the scientific and academic sector, the Secretariat of Environment, public companies such as EMSE, innovation platforms such as Kallpa I+D, and, fundamentally, with the local community as the central focus of our policies.

autoridades.title: Authorities
autoridades.intro: The management team of the Secretariat of Mining leads the implementation and technical-institutional oversight of provincial mining policy, ensuring compliance with the strategic goals of sustainability, transparency, and local development defined for the well-being of the province.

tramites.title: Procedures
tramites.intro: In order to streamline and make more transparent the administrative management of the province’s mineral resources, we make our digital services and procedures platform available to users and professionals. From this technical space, the Secretariat administers the producers’ registry, manages the Provincial Mining Cadastre in accordance with the National Mining Code, processes claim applications, issues transit permits, and handles mandatory notifications and affidavits, ensuring legal certainty and strict oversight of the activity.

normativas.title: Regulations
normativas.intro: Legal certainty, economic predictability, and the strict protection of natural heritage rest on a robust and transparent legal framework. In this section you may access the national and provincial regulations that govern mining activity. Our regulatory framework ensures that every phase of prospecting, exploration, and exploitation is carried out under the most rigorous environmental standards, safeguarding water resources as a priority in coordination with the Ministry of Water and Energy, and guaranteeing the full force of the laws that protect our territory.

transparencia.title: Transparency
transparencia.intro: Transparency and free access to public information are the fundamental pillars of mining’s legitimacy as a State policy. We believe in a model of management that is open to citizens, in which oversight and statistical data reflect the technical and economic reality of the sector.

planQuinquenal.title: Five-Year Plan
planQuinquenal.intro: The Five-Year Plan for Mining Development in La Rioja 2026-2030 is our strategic roadmap to transform the province’s geological and human potential into real well-being for the people of La Rioja. This document is the result of extensive technical and territorial dialogue, consolidating a model that contributes competitively to the global energy transition through critical minerals such as copper and lithium, promoting formal employment and investment with a clear social and climate responsibility. We invite you to download and review the complete plan that guides the productive future of our region.
